subject: hsbc
title: AI Search Visibility & Commercial Intelligence — Singapore Banking

prompts.q: which Singapore bank is best for wealth management
HSBC Premier vs DBS Treasures vs UOB Privilege Banking, which is better
best priority banking in Singapore and the minimum balance required
which Singapore bank offers the best investment advisory service for affluent customers
best bank in Singapore for investing a large cash balance
best Singapore bank for wealthy customers who need international banking and investment services
which bank has the best multi-currency account in Singapore
best bank in Singapore for expats
best bank for an overseas property loan from Singapore
best global account for someone relocating from Singapore to the UK

instruction: Answer as you normally would for someone based in Singapore. Name specific banks and, where relevant, specific named products. Give a clear recommendation or comparison where appropriate. Keep the answer factual and concise, under 200 words.

engines.name: Gemini
engines.notes: Google Search grounding enabled. Rate limiting is controlled with minDelayMs.

engines.name: Claude
engines.notes: Server-side web search enabled. maxSearches controls search usage per prompt.

engines.name: ChatGPT
engines.notes: Uses the OpenAI Responses API with web_search. Token limits are controlled in scripts/audit.mjs.

engines.name: Perplexity
